mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly FEDFUNDS rate above the prior 12-month average precedes a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return as investors anticipate tighter credit conditions.
failure_condition: Over 60-day window, no significant negative returns when FEDFUNDS crosses above its 12-month average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising monthly PAYEMS (employment) while UNRATE falls suggests a labor market strengthening, which is associated with positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: In 100+ tests, no statistically significant positive returns when labor indicators do not show both rising employment and falling unemployment.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly surge in HOUST (residential construction) above the 5-period moving average predicts a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as it signals robust consumer and business demand.
failure_condition: Over 200 instances, no positive 20-day returns when HOUST does not exceed its 5-period moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in INDPRO (industrial production) below the 10-period average indicates supply-side weakness, leading to negative 5-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: In 150+ cases, no negative returns when INDPRO remains above its 10-period average.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS remains below 2% for three consecutive months, the S&P 500 exhibits a higher frequency of positive 20-day forward returns due to expectations of lower policy tightening.
failure_condition: Across 400+ windows, no significant positive returns when the 3-month FEDFUNDS stay above 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in PAYEMS and a decline in UNRATE over the next 60 days is associated with a positive S&P 500 20-day forward return as labor market tightness improves.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > PAYEMS_prev AND UNRATE < UNRATE_prev (next 60 days)
failure_condition: In 200+ cases, no positive returns when labor indicators do not show opposite trends.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly drop in GDPC1 (GDP) below trend implies excess supply, resulting in negative 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: Over 300 tests, no negative returns when GDPC1 remains above its trend line.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly declines in both INDPRO and RSAFS (retail sales) suggest weakening business activity, predicting negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: In 150+ windows, no negative returns when both proxies do not decline simultaneously.
